creators: Karoryfer Samples; recorded by Brian Wood
description: Green Gretsch guitar: two real picked dynamics/takes, captured upward hammer attacks and physical release samples. Keys 35-39 transpose recorded low E.
conversion: Original mono/stereo PCM averaged at 48 kHz PCM16, -65-dB onset with 3-ms preroll/fade-in; body <=3 s, hammer <=2 s, release <=.65 s, 20-ms end fade. No normalization or invented takes; source release decay 5 dB/s. No SFZ runtime.
